list.title: Invoices
list.subtitle: Invoices, manual payments, credit notes and accounting export.
list.searchPlaceholder: Invoice number, customer, work order or line
list.emptyDescription: Create an invoice from a completed work order, a quote, or manually.

new.title: New invoice
new.subtitle: The invoice is saved as a draft. The invoice number is assigned when sent.

form.noContacts: No contacts are registered for this customer.
form.noWorkOrder: Not linked to a work order
form.workOrderHint: Only completed work orders can be invoiced.
form.linesHint: Amounts and VAT are calculated on the server. Each line may use a different VAT rate.

detail.sent: The invoice has been sent and assigned an invoice number.
detail.duplicatePayment: The payment was already registered. Nothing was counted twice.
detail.creditSaved: The credit note has been registered.
detail.noWorkOrder: Not linked to a work order
detail.sendHint: When the invoice is sent, the lines are frozen and a unique invoice number is assigned.
detail.paymentHint: Register a manual payment (bank transfer, cash or other). Card payments happen through the payment link above and are registered automatically.
detail.creditHint: The amount includes VAT and cannot exceed the outstanding amount. The credit note reduces the balance but does not trigger a refund in v1.

print.paymentHint: Payment is made by bank transfer using {reference} as the reference. If the invoice has a payment link, it can also be paid by card or Vipps.

settings.title: Invoicing and quotes
settings.subtitle: Default VAT rate, due date and number sequences. Amounts on sent documents do not change.
settings.hint: The VAT rate is the default for new lines. Existing documents keep their rate.

payment.title: Payment link
payment.hint: The customer can pay with {provider} through a secure link. Card data is handled by the provider, never by this app.
payment.linkCreated: The payment link was created. You can share it with the customer.
payment.notConfigured: The payment provider is not configured.
payment.disabled: The payment provider is not configured.
payment.unsupportedCurrency: The payment provider only supports NOK in this version.
payment.providerError: The payment provider did not respond as expected. Try again.
payment.rateLimited: The payment provider is rate limiting requests. Try again shortly.

accounting.title: Accounting
accounting.neverSynced: The invoice has not been synchronised yet.
accounting.enableHint: Enable accounting sync in settings to use manual sync.
accounting.draftHint: Send the invoice before synchronising it to accounting.
accounting.notConfigured: The accounting provider is not configured.
accounting.syncFailed: The sync failed. The error is saved and can be retried.
accounting.concurrent: A sync is already running for this invoice.
accounting.synced: The invoice was synchronised to accounting.
accounting.alreadySynced: The invoice was already synchronised. Nothing was sent again.
accounting.exported: The invoice was exported to CSV. No external accounting provider was updated.
accounting.reset: The sync was reset and can be run again.
accounting.settingsHint: The provider and keys are set in the environment. Here you can see status and test the connection.
accounting.failedCount: {count} invoice(s) failed and can be retried.

errors.generic: The action could not be completed.
errors.forbidden: You do not have access to do this.
errors.conflict: The invoice is in a state that does not allow this action.
errors.notPayable: The invoice cannot be registered with a payment now.
errors.notCreditable: The invoice cannot be credited now.
errors.amountTooHigh: The amount is higher than the outstanding balance.
errors.duplicateNumber: The number is already in use. Try again.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.intro: Sent invoices and payment status for your account.
invoices.forbidden: You do not have access to the invoices.
invoices.empty: No invoices have been sent yet.
invoices.manualPayment: Payment is made by bank transfer using the invoice number as the reference. If the invoice has a Pay button, you can also pay by card or Vipps.
invoices.payHint: You will be sent to a secure payment page. Card data is never shared with us.
invoices.paymentPending: The payment is registered automatically when the provider confirms it. It may take a few minutes.
